item.title: Notes on: Molmo2: Open Weights and Data for Vision-Language Models with Video Understanding and Grounding by Christopher Clark, Jieyu Zhang, Zixian Ma, Jae Sung Park, Mohammadreza Salehi, Rohun Tripathi, Sangho Lee, Zhongzheng Ren, Chris Dongjoo Kim, Yinuo Yang, Vincent Shao, Yue Yang, Weikai Huang, Ziqi Gao, Taira Anderson, Jianrui Zhang, Jitesh Jain, George Stoica, Winson Han, Ali Farhadi, Ranjay Krishna (2026)
item.description: tags Vision Language Models, Grounding, Synthetic training data, Spatial Reasoning, Foundation models source (Clark et al. 2026) Summary Molmo2 is a family of fully open Vision Language Models (4B, 8B built on Qwen3, and a 7B built on OLMo) trained without distillation from proprietary systems. The work closes the open-source gap for video-capable VLMs with a core focus on Grounding — producing pixel-level pointing and tracking outputs across single images, multi-image sets, and videos — a capability that even proprietary models largely lack.
